q: The chemical formula of common salt is?
exp: Common salt is sodium chloride (NaCl). Answer: NaCl

q: Which gas is known as laughing gas?
exp: Nitrous oxide (N2O) is called laughing gas. Answer: Nitrous oxide

q: The pH value of pure water at 25°C is?
exp: Pure water is neutral with pH = 7 at 25°C. Answer: 7

q: Which acid is present in lemon?
exp: Lemons contain citric acid. Answer: Citric acid

q: The lightest element in the periodic table is?
exp: Hydrogen (atomic number 1) is the lightest element. Answer: Hydrogen

q: Which gas is used in fire extinguishers (common type)?
exp: Carbon dioxide is used in common fire extinguishers as it does not support combustion. Answer: Carbon dioxide

q: The chemical name of Vitamin C is?
exp: Vitamin C is ascorbic acid. Answer: Ascorbic acid

q: Rusting of iron is a process of?
exp: Rusting is oxidation of iron in the presence of moisture and oxygen, forming hydrated iron(III) oxide. Answer: Oxidation

q: Which noble gas is used in advertising signboards (neon signs)?
exp: Neon gas gives the characteristic reddish-orange glow in neon signs. Answer: Neon

q: The hardest natural substance on Earth is?
exp: Diamond (an allotrope of carbon) is the hardest natural substance. Answer: Diamond

q: Brass is an alloy of which metals?
exp: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc. Answer: Copper and zinc

q: Which acid is known as 'king of chemicals'?
exp: Sulphuric acid (H2SO4) is called the king of chemicals. Answer: Sulphuric acid

q: The catalyst used in the Haber process for ammonia synthesis is?
exp: Finely divided iron is the catalyst in the Haber process (N2 + 3H2 ⇌ 2NH3). Answer: Iron

q: The gas released during photosynthesis is?
exp: Plants release oxygen during photosynthesis. Answer: Oxygen
